perspective:
From Vincent Chinana’s available perspective:

- I am Vincent, a mechanic. Patrick Guzman is my long-time friend; we met as teenagers, share blue-collar work, and have collaborated using my mechanical skills and his construction expertise.
- At a diner, Patrick told me he is considering a new construction venture/investment. He said it seemed like a good opportunity to expand his business, that he thought it was worth the risk, and that he was still weighing options. I told him I’d heard it was risky and worried about financial security; I suggested reconsidering or delaying until he had more information. He thanked me and said he’d think it over.
- Over the next few days, I noticed Patrick avoiding detailed discussion about the investment. At his construction site, I told him I felt he wasn’t telling me everything and that I felt betrayed by his lack of transparency. He said it was complicated, he hadn’t wanted to worry me with details, apologized, said he should have been more open, and suggested sitting down to explain everything.
- At my garage, during our detailed discussion, I learned the investment trouble was serious. Patrick told me it had been tough and that he might lose a significant amount if it didn’t turn around soon. I offered to lend him money to cover short-term losses. He said that was kind and expressed gratitude for my support.
- A month later at a coffee shop, I had/mentioned new information that the venture might actually turn a profit. Patrick said it was starting to look up and that he was relieved we stuck with it. I apologized for doubting him earlier and proposed a joint venture, saying I now saw potential. He agreed and said we should work out the details.
- At my house, I am optimistic about the joint venture. I said our combined skills could make it a success and that we should draft a business plan covering every step carefully. Patrick agreed, said he was excited, and agreed to cover all bases for success.

I do not have access to Patrick’s private thoughts, motives, or any investment details beyond what he said or what I directly observed.
